children: is launching its first-ever codeshare partnership with Turkey's low-cost carrier Pegasus Airlines, opening up connections between Southeast Asia and Europe via Istanbul, the airline said on Wednesday.

The partnership initially covers London, Moscow, Athens, Ankara and Zurich, and will progressively open access to more than 100 routes between Asia and Europe via the combined network, AirAsia said in a statement.
